title: Wanda C NDE 5155
content: I get anesthesia whenever I go to the dentist, due to a high level of pain and anxiety. During one particular year, 2004, whenever I would feel myself going under, I would wind up in the same place every time - the hallway outside my old third grade classroom. (This hallway also led to the room where sometimes we were taught music.) The hallway and my classrooms were in the basement of the school, where it was dark and still; that area was isolated from the rest of the school. As I'd drift into sedation, I'd feel a sense of comfort in that dark, still hallway. Until those experiences of sedation at the dentist in 2004, I had never thought about that hallway, either awake or in a dream. It had been thirty years, and yet it felt as familiar as if I had just left there. One time, under sedation, I drifted back into that familiar hallway, but this time I just kept going further in. I began to see my brother and my sister (who were alive and well). At that time, I was sure they were right there with me and we were all little kids again. Some knowledge came to me and it went like this, 'You have been together and in relationship to each other for eternity. You are bonded, and this will always be. Do not be afraid of losing anyone, as this simply does not happen.' I took it to mean that we may live and die during this life, but we will also live and die again and again - together in different forms. The love between us is eternal. Our selves are eternal. Our bond is eternal. In that moment, I lost all fear, and I began to see my human fear of death and loss as a waste of energy. I woke up to shouting and a breathing mask placed over my face. As far as I know, my heart had not stopped. Only my breathing had stopped; and no one knows for sure for how long this was, as they'd left me alone for some time.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Repeatedly found herself in the hallway outside her old third grade classroom as she went under dental anesthesia; one time she 'kept going further in.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw her brother and sister (alive at the time) and experienced them as 'all little kids again.'

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark, still, isolated basement hallway outside an old third-grade classroom (also leading to a music room).

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Woke up to shouting and a breathing mask placed over her face.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Dental anesthesia/sedation; breathing stopped (heart did not stop, to her knowledge).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated anesthesia-associated experience of being in a childhood school hallway; saw living siblings as children; received 'knowledge' about eternal bonds and not fearing loss.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; instead an earthlike memory-location environment recurred during sedation with a communicated message, followed by awakening with respiratory intervention.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The same hallway environment occurred each time she went under anesthesia during that year.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred repeatedly under dental anesthesia, featuring a specific childhood school hallway (basement) that she had not thought about for 30 years; encountered living siblings as children and received a message about eternal relationship and not losing anyone.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'You have been together and in relationship to each other for eternity. You are bonded, and this will always be. Do not be afraid of losing anyone, as this simply does not happen.'
